title: The Supplement of the Gods (Aesthetics & Performance)
summary: NH presents bee pollen as his favourite natural supplement for size and performance, opening with a strong allergy warning and his microdosing protocol for building pollen tolerance. He covers its history (Egypt, Greece, Rome, Native Americans), claimed health and performance benefits, his own experience (energy, fuller look, faster pressing progress, appetite control) and how to take and buy it locally.
claims: If you are allergic to pollen, taking bee pollen can trigger anaphylactic shock and kill you
He started bee pollen three years earlier to fight severe spring pollen allergies without drowsy antihistamines
Microdosing protocol: start in early April with one or two pellets on the tongue once a day, increase frequency and dose slowly, stop if you react
Tingling or numbness on the palate is an allergic reaction that fades with daily exposure; by end of April he tolerates a quarter teaspoon
His allergy made him sneeze about 50 times a day, which weakened his ribs until they broke squatting four plates
Ancient Egyptians, Greeks (ambrosia), Romans and Native Americans used bee pollen for energy, health and athletic or military performance
Bee pollen is claimed to be antioxidant, anti-diabetic, liver- and kidney-protective, and anti-inflammatory
Creatine won't necessarily destroy kidneys but can cause kidney stones in some individuals
He believes bee pollen improves skin, hair quality and digestion, especially on an empty stomach
Studies suggest bee pollen improves protein synthesis
A study suggests bee pollen shifts weight gain toward more muscle and less fat (he uses illustrative 60/40 numbers)
Studies suggest bee pollen users do more volume at higher frequency, recover faster and gain strength faster
Nobody promotes bee pollen because no company can patent or package it profitably
Bee pollen is pollen mixed with nectar and bee saliva; the enzymes from the saliva make it potent
One teaspoon of bee pollen has about 1.2 g protein and 2.18 g carbs for 15 kcal
Bee pollen gives him euphoric, almost manic energy all day; people prone to anxiety may find it worsens it
Every spring when he starts bee pollen he looks fuller and more vascular, especially shoulders and upper arms, and it fades when he stops
His logbooks show his presses jump every spring; currently he adds 5-10 lb to presses roughly every two weeks
A spoonful of bee pollen kills mild hunger, useful when cutting
Dose for an adult male: three teaspoons a day, one on waking (on an empty stomach, delaying breakfast about 90 min), one after lunch and one after dinner
Real farm honey is far better than supermarket honey; he takes a spoon of honey with the bee pollen
Let the bee pollen dissolve fully in your saliva before swallowing to absorb the nutrients
Buy local bee pollen, not from Amazon: it is cheaper, often organic, and local pollen helps with local allergies
A month of organic bee pollen should cost about 10-15 euros or up to 20 dollars; paying more is a scam
Training always beats any supplement; bee pollen without hard work builds nothing
He promotes bee pollen despite calling most supplements useless because it is unrefined, natural and not from the fitness industry
Avoid bee pollen capsules or blends with creatine; buy the real organic pellets
